end.line: Quillon for Kestrelline Logistics’ procurement legal team

vo: Kestrelline Logistics holds eleven hundred supplier contracts across fourteen countries. Here is that work in Quillon.
Vault reads all eleven hundred contracts at once, and every assignment and change of control clause lands in one table.
When procurement sends one of its sixty questions a week, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the contract clause.
And the positions in your forty-page standards document are remembered, so every answer starts from them.
Dana will walk your team through it on Wednesday the nineteenth.
